recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit as-is. Future corrections to the extension definition, code system, value set, status, or replacement wording should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions; core FHIR should only change if an OID registry entry or renewed core-owned artifact decision changes.
issue_request: FHIR-39466 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. The joint PA/PC decision kept Patient as the resource for distinct fetal records, made a non-modifier fetal/born-status extension appropriate, declined an invariant in the base extension, and requested a 0..1 code extension with required born/unborn/fetal-demise/unknown codes.
initial_application: Core FHIR history has 08d0533d4c, a Jira-tagged core commit that added only patient-bornstatus CodeSystem, ValueSet, and StructureDefinition OIDs to source/oids.ini; 33feb5f13d then corrected the StructureDefinition OID. The source-changing implementation landed in the FHIR Extension Pack in 873fb77b77, which created StructureDefinition-patient-bornStatus.xml, CodeSystem-patient-bornstatus.xml, and ValueSet-patient-bornstatus.xml with the required code binding.
additional_context: Patient remains active in core source/fhir.ini, but current core source has no patient-bornStatus definition source outside source/oids.ini. The current Extension Pack contains the bornStatus artifacts as retired/deprecated and contains the later patient-fetalStatus replacement. FHIR-45301, a Published FHIR-extensions issue, deprecated bornStatus and created fetalStatus under Patient Care ownership; FHIR-47030 later clarified the fetalStatus definition and vitality semantics.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The seed belongs to extension definition source outside this core checkout, and the current core OID registry already preserves the relevant canonical/OID mappings.
